# Adapter contract

The framing is stated in [the adapter protocol](../../spec/28_communication-channels.md#2851-ch-adapterbinary).

The published copy of the same section is
[the adapter protocol on the hosted tree](https://github.com/lennylabs/lenny/blob/main/spec/15_external-api-surface.md#1541-adapterbinary-protocol),
which the fragment-link gate does not read.

The link into a file the repository does not track is
[an external note](../../notes/adapter.md#1541-adapterbinary-protocol).
